name: Makab Horazon: Ang Stalker
storyline: A lady is home late from work and has to pass through an unlit alley. But someone was following her...
summary:
Makab Horazon: Ang Stalker is a short game that tests the player's reflexes. The player must guide the Lady and get her home safely with the use of stalling tactics. The length and difficulty of the game may be adjusted according to the player's preferences.

The Stalker follows, so look back at the right time or face the consequence. The player can also perform a fake call, but of course this will only work on the first few tries. The Lady can fight with the help of the player's guidance; she can run, but so can the Stalker. There is a reward for using your resources at the last minute, but when is the last minute? That's for you to find out.
